title: Release @kanbus/ui with the stacked layout and tell the hosts
description: Bump packages/ui to 0.5.0, since hosts get new phone behaviour by default. Document layout, stackedBelowWidth and onColumnNearEnd in packages/ui/README.md, including that layout='columns' opts out. Tag ui-v0.5.0 and confirm the release workflow publishes the tarball. Then tell the Papyrus session (its PPY task consumes this) and check which other hosts pin @kanbus/ui, including Papyrus-web and Chatticus.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Published ui-v0.5.0 with kanbus-ui-0.5.0.tgz. Papyrus adopts it under PPY-7a9355. Other hosts stay on their own pins until bumped: Prospectus-web vendors an organizer tarball, and another host vendors 0.4.2. They get phone stacking only when they bump.
